title: High Protein Cottage Cheese Chicken Elote Dip
description: A delicious, high-protein dip inspired by Mexican street corn, perfect for a healthy snack or a decadent topping.

ingredients.item: Extra cilantro and Tajin for garnish (optional)

steps: Add the drained Mexican style street corn to a mixing bowl.
Blend the cottage cheese in a blender until smooth, then add it to the bowl with the corn.
Add the shredded chicken, chopped cilantro, diced jalapeno, Mexican crema, hot sauce, Tajin, queso fresco, and lime juice to the bowl.
Transfer to a serving dish, garnish with extra cilantro and Tajin if desired, and serve with tortilla chips.
notes:
The serving size is approximately one cottage cheese container's worth. Can be served with tortilla chips or used as a topping for hot dogs.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1GxaU2RcGv/

Nutrition: Serving 1/4 of recipe · Calories 210 kcal · Fat 7g · Saturated fat 3g · Unsaturated fat 4g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 45mg · Sodium 650mg · Carbs 18g · Fiber 2g · Sugar 6g · Protein 22g

healthy: Low fat cottage cheese and chicken make it high in protein.
Corn, jalapeno, cilantro and lime add vegetables.
Lighter than a cream cheese or mayo based dip.
not_healthy: Tajin, hot sauce, canned corn and queso fresco add a lot of sodium.
Mexican crema adds some saturated fat.
